shared_elements: standing human figure in frontal/upright pose
figure holding or associated with objects (raised arm with implement / staff-like element)
smaller subsidiary motifs flanking the main figure
elaborate headgear or head-projections above the figure's head
justification: Both center on a single upright anthropomorphic figure with something raised or projecting from the head and smaller accessory motifs disposed around it, which gives a loosely comparable composition. But the depicted content differs greatly: A is a bare, linear, stick-like silhouette with an axe-like implement, a boat-like sign and simple ladder/animal marks scattered in open field, while B is a densely packed, richly costumed figure with feathered wing-like fans, beaded ornaments, panelled plaques and a profile face at the belt, filling the whole field with no empty ground.
